verdicts.reason: All rules hold: substring quote plus section locator is program-checkable, assisted does not exceed the brief's assisted-to-reliable, one clause type per pass is enforced, the none-found empty result passes, and checkRunnable false is honest.

A3 fails: the brief requires scoring from one party's view, but the done-when rows carry no party field and nothing in the check detects two-party scoring (it is only in the trigger and forbidden list).

All rules hold: the house-clause denominator with one matched/changed/missing row each and the N=M+C+K count is a program check that makes missing and changed rows mandatory and silence never fine, status assisted matches the brief, and checkRunnable false is honest.

All rules hold: the revert-equals-source byte diff, flag-id tagged hunks and line-range bound are a state-diff check covering flagged-only, original-visible, no-deal-rewrite and track-to-flag, zero edits passes, status assisted and gated match the brief, and checkRunnable false is honest.

A3 fails: the brief says quote the holding used, but the done-when only constrains a holding quote if one is present and never requires each kept cite to carry a quoted holding with a locator, so a resolved cite with no holding quote passes.

All rules hold: the in-scope and not-read lists with the N=R+U count, unique issue ids, and read-set membership are program checks covering every brief element, not-read is listed as a result, status assisted with the signature gate absent matches the brief, and checkRunnable false is honest.
